correctness.rationale: Explicit map branch domains/images imply an exact geometric Markov kernel under normalized Lebesgue, with core exit A(lambda) verified by rational algebra. The downward skip-free walk first-passage PGF r solves lambda*r^2-r+z(1-lambda)=0, analytic root generating Catalan coefficients. Core PGF H=z(1-A)+A*r^2=(1-A/lambda)z+(A/lambda)r proves all finite-time masses. Evaluate r(1), differentiate subcritically and use central-binomial tail at lambda=1/2. Stirling, a uniform k^-3/2 majorant, Riemann sum and exact escape mass prove the fixed-u crossover including both signs of u. Direct independent finite-horizon affine partition dynamics checked 934 assertions using packaged source verifier. Source T not assumed conjugate to F.

value.rationale: Ji–Ma identify a dynamical recurrence/wild-attractor threshold but leave finite-time approach to that transition unquantified. The first four levels are the minimal natural nonhomogeneous core; first-return times are a canonical recurrence statistic, not an arbitrary numerical slice. Exact all-time Catalan probabilities with their model-specific normalization, a fully explicit critical survival constant and a crossover interpolating recurrent and escape regimes supply useful sharp quantitative information unavailable from a recurrence classification alone. Proof self-contained and limits clearly restricted to the auxiliary map.
